cards.front: What key point should you remember from Perimeter and Area?
cards.back: 6 PERIMETER AND AREA 6.1 Perimeter Do you remember what the perimeter of a closed plane figure is?

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Perimeter and Area?
cards.back: The perimeter of any closed plane figure is the distance covered along its boundary when you go around it once.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Perimeter and Area?
cards.back: For a polygon, i.e., a closed plane figure made up of line segments, the perimeter is simply the sum of the lengths of its all sides, i.e., the total distance along its outer boundary.

cards.front: What key point should you remember from Perimeter and Area?
cards.back: The perimeter of a polygon = the sum of the lengths of its all sides.
